title: LeaseDocument
description: The Azure Cosmos DB document shape for a single-owner workflow lease.

id.description: The run id the lease guards.

environment.description: The environment half of the guarded run's (environment, runId) address (ADR 0065 decision 9); also the partition key, so the container's (partition key, id) uniqueness is exactly the composite run address.

token.description: The lease token, proving ownership for release.

epoch.description: The grant's epoch: a per-run counter advanced on every grant of this run's lease, persisted so it survives release, expiry and the process that granted it.
